title: Antonia Hane - Communication From Swiss Consulate-General Regarding Whereabouts

page_data.en:
989
13 8 41

August 11 41.

The Swiss Consul-General,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. K.-XVII.B.17.m.- dated July 21, 1941, and to
inform you that exhaustive enquiries have been made
but no trace of the present whereabouts of Miss
Antonia HANE can be found in Shanghai. There is no
record of Miss HANE having arrived in this city
during the past eighteen months.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

K.M. BOURNE
Commissioner of Police.

13 8 41

REPORT

Special Branch Station. File No. Date August 11, 1941.

SUBJECT: Antonia HANE - Communication from Swiss
Consulate-General regarding whereabouts.

Exhaustive enquiries made in collaboration
with the French Police have failed to establish
that any Swiss lady named Antonia HANE arrived
in Shanghai during the past eighteen months.
Similarly no trace of her present whereabouts
in Shanghai can be found.

（印：POLICE AUG 11 1941 ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER SPECIAL BRANCH）
A.C. (Special Branch).

Jn. Price

政治部分局。档案编号。日期：1941年8月11日。

主题：安东尼娅·哈内（Antonia HANE）——瑞士总领事馆关于其下落的去函。

经与法国警察合作进行详尽查询，未能证实过去十八个月内有任何名为安东尼娅·哈内的瑞士女士抵达上海。同样，在上海也未能找到她目前下落的任何踪迹。

（印：POLICE AUG 11 1941 ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER SPECIAL BRANCH）

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL DE SUISSE
EN CHINE

（批：Acknowledged. (form E)
Central Rec. 22 / 7 1941
Letter from）

K.-XVII.B.17.a.-

Shanghai, July 21st 1941.    989
                             23  7  41

Sir,

        I have the honour to let you know that I received
a letter from the relatives of Miss Antonia HANE, a Swiss
citizen, in which they inquire about her whereabouts. Miss
Hane left Sans Francisco during the summer 1940 for Shanghai
where she intended to take up a position as secretary. The
last news her relatives received from was a post-card,
picturing the Park Hotel, in which she mentioned her arrival
in Shanghai and said that she would write more soon. Since
then they have not heard from her.

        My inquiries at the Park Hotel, as well as my adver-
tisements in the local newspapers, were without results.

        I should therefore be grateful if you would let me
know whether you have the name of Antonia HANE on your
records. Any information on the above-mentioned would oblige
me greatly.

        The same request has been addressed to the Police
Services of the French Concession.

                                I have the honour to be,
                                        Sir,
                                Your obedient servant,

                                （签名：Emil Cammaert）
                                SWISS CONSUL GENERAL

To the Commissioner of Police,
    Shanghai Municipal Police,
        SHANGHAI.

瑞士驻中国总领事馆

（批：已收悉。(E表)
中央登记处 1941年7月22日
来信来自）

K.-XVII.B.17.a.-

上海，1941年7月21日。    989
                             23  7  41

先生：

谨此告知，我收到瑞士公民安东尼娅·哈内（Antonia HANE）小姐亲属的来信，信中询问她的下落。哈内小姐于1940年夏季离开旧金山（Sans Francisco）前往上海，打算在那里担任秘书一职。她的亲属收到的最后消息是一张明信片，上面印有国际饭店（Park Hotel）的照片，她在片中提到已抵达上海，并表示不久后会再写信详述。自那以后，他们便未再收到她的音讯。

我在国际饭店进行的查询以及在本地报纸上刊登的广告均未取得结果。

因此，如蒙告知贵处记录中是否有安东尼娅·哈内之名，我将不胜感激。任何关于上述情况的信息都将使我深表感谢。

同样的请求也已致函法租界警务部门。

                                谨此致意，
                                        先生，
                                您顺从的仆人，

                                （签名：Emil Cammaert）
                                瑞士总领事

致警务处处长，
    上海公共租界工部局警务处，
        上海。
